evals.name: author-import
evals.prompt: Import an author from a service that has its AuthorId and name.
evals.expected_output: Await the command pipeline and branch on the outcome.
assertions: Branches on IsSuccess and reports failure before marking import complete.

evals.name: failed-import
evals.prompt: An author import returned an unsuccessful command result. Which properties distinguish the causes?
assertions: Uses ValidationResults or HasExceptions as appropriate.
Consults IsRetryable before treating a failure as retryable.

evals.name: command-response
evals.prompt: A service needs the typed response of an existing command. Is a non-null response enough to assume success?
evals.expected_output: Use the typed pipeline overload and verify success.
assertions: Uses Execute<TResponse> for a typed Response.
Does not call Handle directly or pass an unrelated provider.
